note: residual cap at the forced neighbour: after every step kappa of a strict bounded forward tour the block queried next, Q/v, has eps(Q/v) = gh_shift + res_ratio + gap with gap >= 0 (lambda_1(Q/v) <= lambda_1(P/v), P/v the queried block's HKZ residual); in-tour census per (d, beta, seed, tour) and the random-lattice control of res_ratio
note_model: thinned-residual model: the residual's sign pairs are thinned by the minimality of the inserted vector (a point of norm rho < ||v|| survives iff its lift's offset exceeds sqrt(||v||^2 - rho^2); thinning factor (1 - 2 sqrt(1 - rho^2))^+), integrated over the control's own eps(P); the undercut law treats the layers of Q/v over P/v as unthinned Poisson cosets at heights j ||b_{kappa+beta}^*||
